Class PackageAdapter

java.lang.Object
com.example.bluej.PackageAdapter
All Implemented Interfaces:
bluej.extensions2.event.PackageListener
public class PackageAdapter extends Object implements bluej.extensions2.event.PackageListener
Author:
Krece Hayes Adapter: converts BlueJ's package events into EventType.PROJECT_OPENED and EventType.PROJECT_CLOSED events.
